card.name: End of FDA CompanionDiagnostics web link
card.fires_on: The word piece "iagnostics" finishing the web address www.fda.gov/CompanionDiagnostics, in sentences saying FDA-approved test information is available at that link. Rarely, it fires on "olic" in "thromboembolic".
